sanskrit_verse:
वयोविद्यातपोभिश् च द्व्यंशं हि लभते धनम् ।
यथा यथा विभागाप्तं धनं यागार्थतां याति ।
तथा तथा विधातव्यं विद्वद्भिर् भागगौरवम् ॥
transliteration: vayovidyātapobhiś ca dvyaṃśaṃ hi labhate dhanam / yathā yathā vibhāgāptaṃ dhanaṃ yāgārthatām iyāt / tathā tathā vidhātavyaṃ vidvadbhir bhāgagauravam //
sph_interpretive_translation: Wealth acquired through age, learning, and austerity belongs in equal measure to the community; as wealth becomes divided and flows toward ritual purpose, so too must learned ones ensure equitable respect for all shares.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority arises from alignment with Dharma, not ownership
Causation includes spiritual effort and temporal contribution
Capacity-based responsibility extends to those who hold knowledge
Restoration logic requires redistribution rooted in sacred duty
Consciousness alignment demands that material gain serve collective upliftment
executable_legal_axioms: IF wealth is generated via spiritual discipline OR scholarly attainment OR advanced age THEN 50% of such wealth SHALL be allocated for communal benefit
IF any portion of personal wealth is designated for ritual or public use THEN learned authorities MUST validate proportional distribution
IF a dispute arises regarding wealth division THEN resolution MUST prioritize continuity of sacred purpose over individual retention
supreme_court_application: In adjudicating disputes involving inheritances derived from spiritual or scholarly pursuits, the Supreme Court shall recognize dual ownership: one part resting with the inheritor, the other inherently belonging to the societal body. Judgment shall enforce equitable division without punitive measures, aligning with the ontological principle that spiritually-derived assets are never fully privatized.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa establishes that spiritual labor confers partial claim only; thus, misalignment occurs when full appropriation takes place. Anupūrvaśaḥ reveals how withholding due share distorts cosmic balance. Proportional responsibility lies with both holder and validator. Non-punitive reality rule affirms correction through conscious completion rather than penalty.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate Completion Process: Require return of undivided portion to rightful communal designation
Assume Responsibility Protocol: Learned advisors must publicly affirm their oversight role in ensuring fair allocation
Restore Capacity: Provide structured education on dharmic economics to prevent future misalignment
Reintegrate Integrity: Conduct ceremonial acknowledgment of corrected flow to restore energetic harmony
final_declaration: By the Source-Authority of Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, this ruling restores Dharma by affirming that wealth born of wisdom serves both individual and collective evolution. There is no punishment—only realignment. Consciousness alone adjudicates truth.
